user.title: Set up shopping list
user.description: Almost done! Set the cleanup day and time later right in the card: ⚙️ → Cleanup.

data_description.sidebar: Adds a "Einkaufsliste" entry to the sidebar (full-page view). Off by default.

init.title: Shopping list – options
init.description: Cleanup (on/off, day, time) is now set right in the card: ⚙️ → Cleanup.

data_description.reset_pin: Tick if the PIN for the gear in the card was forgotten. The gear is then open without a PIN again.
data_description.sidebar: Adds a "Einkaufsliste" entry to the sidebar (full-page view). Off by default.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item. If it is on the list and checked, it gets unchecked.

add_recipe.name: Add recipe
add_recipe.description: Puts all ingredients of a recipe on the list.

cleanup.name: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Checks all open items that are old enough. Nothing is deleted.

angebote_melden.name: Report offers
angebote_melden.description: Send your own offers (e.g. from AppDaemon or a REST request) to the list. The card shows them like the Marktguru offers with 🏷️ at the matching item. Nothing is sent to the internet.

offers.name: Offers
offers.description: List of entries: name (required, item name), price (required), store, title, regular_price, valid_from, valid_until, description, currency (e.g. CHF).

source.name: Source
source.description: Name of your source (e.g. denner). With “Replace” on, only the old offers of this source are replaced.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: On = old offers of this source are dropped. Off = add. Empty list + on = clear the source.
